```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


width, height = 1500, 760
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Geometries independents i topologia explícita d’arcs i nodes</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Dos panells comparen les mateixes formes. A l’esquerra, cada polígon i cada línia conserva les seves coordenades de manera independent, de manera que les fronteres es dupliquen i els extrems poden quedar pròxims sense coincidir. A la dreta, una topologia explícita manté una sola frontera compartida i arcs que es relacionen mitjançant un node persistent.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    '      .background { fill: #f7f9fa; }',
    '      .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c5d0d5; stroke-width: 2; }',
    '      .heading { fill: #21313c; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .subheading { fill: #53656e; font-size: 27px; }',
    '      .label { fill: #263943; font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; }',
    '      .note { fill: #53656e; font-size: 27px; }',
    '      .area-a { fill: #82bad0; fill-opacity: .48; stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 5; }',
    '      .area-b { fill: #e5aa73; fill-opacity: .48; stroke: #a9572f; stroke-width: 5; }',
    '      .line { fill: none; stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 11; stroke-linecap: butt; }',
    '      .duplicate { fill: none; stroke: #c84232; stroke-width: 5; stroke-dasharray: 9 7; }',
    '      .bad-node { fill: #c84232; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .arc { fill: none; stroke: #176486; stroke-width: 11; stroke-linecap: butt; }',
    '      .shared { fill: none; stroke: #2f875f; stroke-width: 9; }',
    '      .node { fill: #2f875f; stroke: #ffffff; stroke-width: 4; }',
    '      .guide { fill: none; stroke: #7f8d93; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 8 7; }',
    '    </style>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <rect width="1500" height="760" class="background"/>',
    '  <rect x="25" y="25" width="710" height="710" class="panel"/>',
    '  <rect x="765" y="25" width="710" height="710" class="panel"/>',
    '  <text x="60" y="78" class="heading">Geometries independents</text>',
    '  <text x="60" y="116" class="subheading">coordenades desades per separat</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="78" class="heading">Arcs i nodes explícits</text>',
    '  <text x="800" y="116" class="subheading">relacions mantingudes pel model</text>',

    # Independent polygon boundaries can duplicate or diverge.
    '  <polygon points="70,165 337,165 350,395 70,395" class="area-a"/>',
    '  <polygon points="370,165 690,165 690,395 385,395" class="area-b"/>',
    '  <path d="M 350,165 L 365,395" class="duplicate"/>',
    '  <path d="M 370,165 L 385,395" class="duplicate"/>',
    '  <text x="220" y="285" text-anchor="middle" class="label">P1</text>',
    '  <text x="535" y="285" text-anchor="middle" class="label">P2</text>',
    '  <text x="367" y="430" text-anchor="middle" class="note">dues còpies del límit</text>',

    # Independent lines have near, but distinct, endpoints.
    '  <path d="M 90,610 L 330,610" class="line"/>',
    '  <path d="M 355,600 L 665,505" class="line"/>',
    '  <path d="M 365,620 L 650,690" class="line"/>',

    '  <circle cx="365" cy="620" r="13" class="bad-node"/>',
    '  <text x="350" y="555" text-anchor="middle" class="note">extrems independents</text>',

    # Explicit topology stores one common boundary and identifies its nodes.
    '  <polygon points="810,165 1100,165 1100,395 810,395" class="area-a"/>',

    '  <text x="1100" y="430" text-anchor="middle" class="note">una frontera compartida</text>',

    # Network arcs reference one persistent junction node.
    '  <path d="M 830,610 L 1100,610" class="arc"/>',
    '  <path d="M 1100,610 L 1400,505" class="arc"/>',
    '  <path d="M 1100,610 L 1390,690" class="arc"/>',
    '  <circle cx="1100" cy="610" r="15" class="node"/>',
    '  <text x="945" y="590" text-anchor="middle" class="label">A2</text>',

    '  <text x="1265" y="680" text-anchor="middle" class="label">A4</text>',
    '  <text x="1100" y="655" text-anchor="middle" class="note">node N1</text>',
    '</svg>',
]

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/04-model-vectorial-digitalitzacio/arc-node-spaghetti.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
